status: prototype harness layout; dressed fit, splice pull strength and electrical operation are untested
lead_labels: All four extension leads are black. Mark pin numbers at both ends before assembly and check continuity against the saved PCB pin map.
bend_basis: Static dressing limit chosen at five times the 1 mm maximum individual-lead insulation diameter. It is a design requirement for these separate leads, not a published flex-life rating.
bundle_basis: The CAD represents maximum dressed envelopes, not four exact wire surfaces. Measure the sleeved bundle and splices; these limits must hold for the shown route to fit.
fan_exit_basis: Nominal lead opening identified in the manufacturer STEP and drawing. The factory-installed exit is screened against the real housing; its small entry region is exempt from the coarse rectangular maximum-body box.
saved_board_endpoint: BFB04512HHA-CZ0T; the candidate uses the same saved electrical pin map. No schematic, PCB or firmware changes are made by this case layout.
splice_support: Printed brace on the existing front-inner fan post; replaces 1 mm of spacer height and supports the splice region beside the fan. Guide fit, stiffness and creep require a sample.
guide_fit_requirement: Fit removable liners or sleeves to the measured loom so it stays within the 0.2 mm positioning budget. Maximum bundle diameters are not the actual finished dimensions.
card_space_basis: Conservative plan boxes around the saved J10/H3 and J40/H4 datums, including the existing 6 mm installed card/retainer height limit. These are selection envelopes, not measured cards; antenna plugs, thermal accessories and insertion motion need separate confirmation.
